svg.title: A black hole and its thermal boundary description
svg.desc: An original schematic spatial cutaway of a gravitational bulk and its boundary quantum field theory. A cyan central black-hole horizon and a faint indigo boundary shell identify the black hole and thermal state, respectively. Below their labels, the Bekenstein-Hawking area entropy and the boundary thermal von Neumann entropy are joined by an approximate equality, with the constants k_B, c and hbar restored. Time and dimensions are suppressed.
